prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production 2x2 static compact garden prop sheet for the existing pixel-art puppy courtyard.
Use the visible original courtyard and dressed-reference images immediately above as the visual context. Generate exactly the FOUR compact objects visible in the dressed reference, isolated as reusable sprites. Preserve their identity, muted olive/tan/terracotta palette, dusty pink and lavender-blue accents, crisp pixel clusters, dark warm outlines, warm upper-left lighting and front-facing slightly elevated RPG perspective. Match the native pixel-art courtyard, not smooth HD painting, photorealism, vector shapes, isometric diamonds or 3D voxels.
Exactly two rows and two columns, equal invisible square cells on a square image. Row-major: top-left a compact round terracotta flower pot filled with small cream and dusty-pink blossoms and dark olive foliage; top-right a rounded low hydrangea shrub with blue-lavender flower clusters and olive leaves; bottom-left a compact pair of rounded weathered gray-green stones with soft moss caps, one slightly taller stone and one smaller stone; bottom-right a round brown ceramic water jar, visible teal water in its oval opening, two green lotus leaves and one pale pink lotus blossom. The jar is squat, not a tall vase. The stones are a compact roughly square cluster, not a wide wall or terrain platform.
Each entire object occupies only the central 55 to 60 percent of its cell, centered, full silhouette contained with at least 20 percent clear margin on every side. Use consistent medium pixel detail suitable for eventual 32 to 44 world-pixel prop sizes. No part, leaf, petal or rim may touch or cross cell boundaries. Ground contact edge clearly defined, but NO ground, grass patch, floor plane, cast shadow, scene backdrop, loose particles or glow.
Background exactly solid flat #FF00FF magenta everywhere outside the objects. No gradients, texture, grid lines, cell borders, labels, writing, numbers, arrows, UI, watermark, animals or people. Do not include the courtyard or house in this asset sheet.
